articles.headline: Unitree prices Shanghai IPO at $904 million as humanoid robot demand surges
articles.summary: Chinese robot maker Unitree priced its Shanghai IPO at 150.80 yuan per share and aims to raise 6.1 billion yuan, making it the first mainland-listed humanoid robot manufacturer. The deal was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed, signaling strong investor appetite for robotics that could reshape automation demand, supplier spending, and long-term labor costs.

articles.headline: CoreWeave raises spending plan after AI cloud demand beats estimates
articles.summary: CoreWeave increased its 2026 capital spending forecast after posting stronger-than-expected quarterly results, citing surging demand for AI cloud computing services. For businesses, the key implication is that AI infrastructure demand remains intense, which can keep capacity tight and cloud costs elevated for companies relying on large-scale model training or inference.

articles.headline: US productivity rises faster than expected as firms invest in AI
articles.summary: U.S. worker productivity grew faster than expected in the second quarter, and Reuters says further gains are likely as businesses invest in artificial intelligence. For business leaders, this points to AI continuing to support output growth while helping contain wage inflation, which can affect hiring plans, pricing, and margins.
